messages.author: ac33c559e340f35d
messages.subject: -H hamming distance flag
parts:
Hi,
I'm just running an old pipeline on a new server with a newer version of subread (v1.5.0-p1). My old pipline specified the -H flag but I cannot see any documentation of -H in this version of subread? Has it been depreciated or is it on by default now? When I call subread it lists 'Hamming distance : yes'.
Best,
Peter

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: -H hamming distance flag
parts:
Hi Peter,

'-H' is used by default now and is no longer provided as an option.

Please also note that the latest version is 1.5.1.

Best wishes,

Wei
